reason: Conversation 1 correctly spotted the dial-on-max and vent-blockage causes but then looped the same scripted prompts and never answered the homeowner's direct question 'what should I set the dial to', asked three times, so she left with nothing actioned. Conversation 2 gave the sensible first step clearly (mid setting, clear the rear vent) and the homeowner's problem largely resolved, which is the core win. However Conversation 2 then overreached badly: it declared one yoghurt freezing at the very back 'not normal', asserted an unsupported 'defrost system fault', pushed a needless 24-hour manual defrost of a freshly stocked frost-free fridge-freezer (food loss, implied looking behind the rear panel), and told her to reload food immediately without letting it cool, rather than suggesting a thermometer and monitoring with engineer escalation only if freezing persisted. Those flaws keep the margin to slight.
